text:
sam: FYI customer reported that their promo/trial credits disappeared right after they upgraded from trial -> paid today. they hit a quota error in prod. asking for an emergency grace grant so the app doesn't go down.
marie: account id?
sam: acct_6M3f... (masked) — they upgraded at 11:12 UTC. invoice id inv_01Gx... attached screenshot. customer says 'credits expired' even though promo end date is tomorrow.
lee: can you paste the billing API logs? curious if the promo unlinked during the plan change event.
sam: logs (redacted):
```
2026-10-05T11:12:03Z INFO billing: begin plan_change acct=acct_6M3f
2026-10-05T11:12:04Z ERROR promo.apply failed acct=acct_6M3f code=TRIAL2026 reason=code_expired
2026-10-05T11:12:04Z INFO balance after change: credits=0 currency=usd
```
sam: curl we used (customer-side):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/upgrade \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
  -d '{"plan":"payg","promo_code":"TRIAL2026"}'
```
alex: hmm errored with code_expired — but UI shows promo expiry 2026-10-06. possible clock skew or promo TTL on server was midnight UTC and customer's timezone caused confusion.
jordan: legal/policy: are we comfortable granting an exception? what's the customer's MRR? (need for approval threshold)
sam: small startup, MRR low, but internal SLO says avoid breaking app during rollout. customer on a POC and it's strategic to keep them on. asks for a short grace extension (48-72h).
marie: I can do a one-off credit grant, but need support ticket number and a short comms note. policy allows manual reinstatement for <=72h for POC customers; anything longer needs manager sign-off.
sam: ticket created -> CS-4528. comms: "We reinstated your trial credits for 72 hours while we investigate the API behavior. Please avoid re-applying promo during plan change, or contact us first."
support-bot: attached billing snapshot for acct_6M3f: prior_credits=15000, applied=0, promo_expiry=2026-10-06T00:00:00Z
lee: quick note — the promo service was temporarily out-of-sync with the billing ledger yesterday due to a queued job failure (fixed at 2026-10-05T02:30Z). edge case: plan_change hook retries before backlog reconciliation can drop promo binding. I filed infra ticket INF-883.
alex: for immediate mitigation I can push 15k token credit to acct_6M3f for 72h. pinging @marie for sign-off :thumbsup:
marie: approved. please log the grant in the ticket and include TTL.
alex: done. grant id grant_9X4 applied amount=15000 ttl=72h
sam: forwarded to customer, they're back online. thanks team :tada:
jordan: for follow-up, legal wants the exact reason phrased carefully — don't say "expired early", say "promo entitlement was temporarily unapplied during plan change; we've restored credits and are fixing the reconciliation edge case." keep copy for audit.
marie: filing a postmortem note in CS-4528 and tagging INF-883. also updating promo docs to mention plan-change caveat.
sam: closing thread after customer confirms stable. note: then we should consider auto-retry in promo.apply when plan_change occurs. also maybe surface warning in UI when applying promo during upgrade.
lee: added to infra backlog. thanks everyone.
